title: 1736 Prairie: straight front walk, wall round the corner
items: The front walk at 1736 Prairie runs straight from the stair to the sidewalk; the wall's opening now sits in line with the stair.
The coping wall is one height across the front, and it turns the 18th Street corner and runs back along the side to the first bay.
The stray stone pier beside the stair's foot is gone.
